title: Saga message envelope
description: Fields present on every saga message. Repeated on each message type rather than nested, so a consumer reads a business field without unwrapping.

messageId.description: Unique identity of THIS message. The consumer idempotency key. Never reused, including on republish. Distinct from showId, which identifies a concert.

sagaId.description: Correlates every message in one order's lifecycle. Always equal to orderId. Also the partition key, which is what guarantees per-order ordering.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened, not when it was published. UTC, ISO-8601.

schemaVersion.description: Starts at 1. Incremented only on a breaking change. A consumer meeting an unrecognised value routes the message to the .DLT channel without processing it.
